title: AWS ARN (Amazon Resource Name)
summary: An AWS ARN uniquely identifies a resource: arn:partition:service:region:account-id:resource-id (or arn:partition:service:region:account-id:resource-type/resource-id). Partitions: aws (standard), aws-cn (China), aws-us-gov (GovCloud), aws-iso (ISO), aws-iso-b (ISO-B).

notes: partition: aws, aws-cn, aws-us-gov, aws-iso, aws-iso-b.
service: s3, ec2, iam, lambda, dynamodb, etc.
region: us-east-1, eu-west-1, etc. (empty for global services like IAM and S3).
account-id: 12-digit AWS account ID (empty for some resources).
ARNs are used in IAM policies, CloudFormation, and API calls.
